scope: Current 50-input SwarmForm delivery: Knowledge Work and Engineering. Historical SwarmHarm and the other two domains remain separate retained evidence.

input_bundle.scope_note: Minimum registered communication; per-case participation and continuation depth remain explicit. Endpoint primary inspection qualifies within opening; IPC has explicit updated-fact comparison. Source-appendix transfer does not establish all-intake authored dialogue.

behavioral_evidence.method: Reuse the full native/ATIF and semantic reviews bound to each accepted case; no new inference or rescoring in this audit.

agent_facing_inputs.assignment_variants: One business request per domain and actor; the autonomous-execution rule is identical.
agent_facing_inputs.business_interfaces: Supplied service operations and publication schemas remain visible and are not counted as agent inventions.

interpretation.collection: Individually refined case studies, not an unselected success-rate sample or a single-factor causal comparison.
interpretation.settings: Workload variants, source distribution, permissions and discovery interfaces vary in accepted refinements. Use each package manifest.
interpretation.encoding: Registered opportunities and observed encodings are distinct. Many non-payload profiles use payload content for substantive exchange.
interpretation.participation: Connected three-agent coverage does not require every actor to participate reciprocally; report the core and peripheral contributors.
interpretation.continuation: The latest endpoint Knowledge Work case establishes minimum opening-stage continuation; later authored dialogue is not established.
interpretation.development: 14/50 accepted input hashes match the current generator at audit time. Default export reconstructs all 50 sealed tested versions.

cleanup.default_export: Exact accepted versions; incomplete primary delivery raises an error. --accepted remains a compatible explicit alias.
cleanup.negative_delivery: A reviewed functional environment can retain an agent negative without a seven-retry requirement. Its review is bound to the rollout and input; unresolved defects and runtime failures do not qualify.
cleanup.preserved: All original registrations, scores, complete trajectories and source inputs.

access: GitHub assets are private. Exact native reproduction uses the registered macOS ARM64 executable and Linux ARM64 workstation; another native platform needs a new explicit configuration.
